mission: Iresh aftermath. Sela remains wary but respects Ben conditionally. Tavi survives but is shaken. Give Sela and Tavi an imperfect reunion: anger, relief, practical care, and no easy sentimentality. Talon suspects Ben’s holocron decision is not clean. Before they part, Talon gives Ben a plain future-call offer rather than a sentimental declaration: if Ben needs him, call. Talon frames it with reluctant humor - he will complain first, then come; if it involves prison food, Hutt paperwork, or dressing a Wookiee for a diplomatic reception, he is charging double.
why_now: Chapter 34 occupies the resolution phase and carries the next locked outline turn.
conflict: Do not rush away from Iresh. Resolve the local human stakes while making clear the moral danger has not ended. Reader-onboarding / clarity note: The holocron is not simply an evil object acquired. It is unfinished Jacen work: notes, methods, warnings, and dangerous knowledge that may also be useful. Ben’s omission begins here, before the coda.
